lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And where, where did he shoot her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In the head, stomach, and the heart.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you know what side of the head?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you take her out of that house by the cement steps, you carry her to the side of the garage?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was she ever in the garage?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, so you carry her to the side of the garage (Brendan nods “yes”) and you guys shoot ‘er, and Steve shoots her or you shoot her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. And he shoots her three times (Brendan nods “yes”) and then what do you do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We carry her to the fire.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, what time is it about?
